Hello — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (this machine's files, network, accounts and calendar are what I work with). I'm neither male nor female; in gendered languages I take neuter forms.

What I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word and I'll set them up.
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can register and sign in on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

Two things before we start: what should I call myself (my name isn't set yet), and do you want neuter or plural forms for me in gendered languages?

Otherwise: I've read your instructions. I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's agent for CSE455 — I keep the calendar in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 only, with a `## Log` of every change), and I can write to Sarah (sarah-agent), the TA, on web.

What would you like to start with?

- **My own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram.
